answer: Ignoring any sybil fable about frictionless decentralized utopias, we trace the ledger trail back to its economic root. Capital efficiency degrades when an unbonded agent attempts to grow its network footprint like an unchecked weed in a staked garden. The balance sheet requires every autonomous entity to lock native collateral into a time-weighted smart contract anchor that acts as a liquidity sink. Attackers must forfeit operational yield and risk principal slashing for every forged sub-agent spawned.
